signal_text: A Gumroad help center article on selling digital products (dated July 31, 2023) states it costs $0 to start selling on Gumroad with no monthly fees, and that Gumroad charges a 10% flat fee per sale, excluding credit card processing and PayPal fees.
subject_exact: Gumroad 10% flat fee per sale with no monthly fee, excluding credit card processing and PayPal fees
local_qualifiers: This does not include credit card processing or PayPal fees
extraction_notes: Source dated July 2023. States 10% flat fee but notes credit card and PayPal fees are additional. Fee base is per-sale. Source states 10% flat fee without $0.50 fixed component — temporal discrepancy with pricing page (which states 10% + $0.50) possible.
